title: More Snow
description: A simple Minecraft mod that adds a new type of snow to the game
body:
This mod adds a new type of snow: blue snow.

This blue snow has several uses: 
- Firstly, it allows you to make snowballs that create an effect similar to powder snow when they hit an enemy
- It also allows you to create a snow golem, which attracts creepers – very useful for creeper farms.

**This mods requires Fabric API and Fabric Kotlin Language**

## Craft

## Blue Snow Golem
To spawn the blue snow golem, you need two blue snow block and a blue snow golem core.

![First block : Blue Snow Block, Second Block: Blue Snow Block, Third Block: Blue Snow Golem Core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9539bf4223a1be93a7e98bbd2584ef5b037055d_0.webp)
